environment.description: EKS cluster running the ingest consumer as a Deployment in namespace 'data-pipeline'. The pod runs as root (default EKS AMI, no securityContext override). The SQS queue has a permissive policy allowing any authenticated AWS principal to SendMessage with arbitrary message attributes. No service mesh is deployed. The /data/staging volume is an EBS gp3 volume mounted at the host path, and the container has write access to the entire filesystem including /etc/cron.d and /root/.ssh/authorized_keys.
